visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, shoulder-length wavy hair is seated at a desk, looking directly at the camera. He is wearing a maroon crew-neck T-shirt and a silver astronaut-shaped necklace. His facial expression is attentive as he speaks. Behind him is a cream-colored wall and a light green curtain. To his left, a large black studio microphone and a yellow-capped plastic cup are visible on the desk. A hand unexpectedly enters the frame from the left side, holding a small white paper receipt and a red-and-white snack package, presenting them to the man. (2) The camera switches to a sharp close-up focus on the "Pasta BLACKCOCOA" snack package. The packaging is primarily red and white with a prominent photograph of dark chocolate shaped like pasta on a plate. The man's hands are visible at the edges, holding the package against a background that appears to be a retail shelf with various other snacks. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the text and imagery on the product wrapper. (3) Returning to a medium shot, the man is seen tearing the top of the snack package open with both hands. His fingers are adorned with a dark purple beaded bracelet. Inside the package, a clear plastic tray is revealed, containing several thick, dark brown chocolate strands that mimic the appearance of fettuccine pasta. A small, bright red two-pronged plastic fork is nestled on top of the chocolate. The man smiles broadly, showing a playful and curious expression while looking down at the contents. (4) The man uses the small red fork to hook and lift a single strand of the dark brown chocolate. He holds the chocolate up toward the camera, showcasing its flexible and slightly glossy texture. He then brings the chocolate to his mouth and takes a large bite. His eyes widen in a comical expression of surprise as he begins to chew. The desk area remains the primary setting, with the keyboard and miscellaneous papers visible in the foreground under soft indoor lighting. (5) In the final phase, the man continues to speak enthusiastically while holding the opened tray. He leans closer to the camera to show the "noodle" texture being pulled by the fork, demonstrating its sticky and elastic nature. He laughs heartily, with his eyes squinting and mouth wide open. The background remains consistent with the studio-like home office setup, featuring the light-colored wall and microphone. Yellow Variety text overlays appear sporadically at the bottom of the screen to emphasize his humorous comments.
